prompt:
Use the supplied reference as the fixed character design. Make a transparent 3 by 3 animation pose-source atlas for a Windows chibi cursor character. Subject: a cute chibi adaptation of the adult white-haired ChatGPT dragon woman in the LEFT reference panel, with a large expressive head and small fully clothed body. Preserve in EVERY pose: two upward curved white ridged dragon horns, very long silvery-white hair, pale violet eyes, lavender bat-like dragon wings behind her shoulders, a thick pale lavender scaly dragon tail curled beside her feet and visibly attached to her body, white ankle-length flowing dress with lavender inner lining and white detached flowing sleeves, small recognizable white interwoven knot ornaments at hair and waist, white closed shoes. Keep the horns, both wings and the complete tail visible and unclipped in every pose. Palette ivory, soft lavender and silver; crisp fine anime outlines, soft polished cel shading, high clarity at small cursor sizes, comparable cute quality to a premium anime desktop companion. White gown and the dragon silhouette must distinguish her from mint-haired Astra.
Exactly nine separate complete figures arranged in a spacious 3x3 grid, one figure per cell, equal scale and consistent design, broad fully transparent gutters between figures. Row1: idle welcoming smile; thoughtful review holding a small lavender book; working holding a compact tablet. Row2: cheerful waving with one hand while full horns/wings/tail remain; stepping gently to the right; stepping gently to the left. Row3: delighted small jump with closed happy eyes; patient waiting pose gently holding a tiny soft blue cloud-shaped companion attached to her palm; mildly disappointed/cannot-use expression, cute rather than distressed. Props must touch the character so the figure and prop remain one joined silhouette. Each cell includes all hair, horns, hands, dress hem, shoes, wings and entire tail. Plain actual transparent RGBA background, no white background, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no shadow floor, no labels, no titles, no frame border, no watermark. Requested atlas about 1536x1536, sufficient space around each complete pose.
